title: 英伟达CEO变动不改AI主线 市场聚焦产品与政策变量
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Chris, how do you view this? The key man risk is sort of an idiosyncratic, a singular risk for Nvidia,
segments.zh: 克里斯，你怎么看？关键人物风险对英伟达来说是一种特殊风险，

segments.en: or are we going to see that sort of broader macro risk across the rest of the industry and AI landscape?
segments.zh: 还是说我们会看到整个行业和AI领域出现更广泛的宏观风险？

segments.en: What I would say at this moment is an idiosyncratic situation, it's an execution risk, it's a PR risk, it's a, you know, what happens with, you know,
segments.zh: 目前我认为这是一个特殊状况，是执行风险，是公关风险，是……你知道，

segments.en: government controls, I mean, it was, it was told that, just one was going to be pulled in front of Congress, the Democrats were pushing for that, being subpoenaed,
segments.zh: 政府管制方面，我的意思是，据说有人会被带到国会面前，民主党人推动此事，发出传票，

segments.en: and, you know, I think given that the Nvidia are such a, an important warning in effective for the US-China AIR race,
segments.zh: 而且我认为，鉴于英伟达在中美AI竞赛中是一个重要的警告因素，

segments.en: they're effectively an asset for the US and strategic asset for the US government in that situation, and they've been right to the helm,
segments.zh: 它们实际上是美国的一项资产，是美国政府在那 situation 中的战略资产，而且它们一直掌舵，

segments.en: so long in that situation and have constraints, and obviously government don't want to be known as being an anti-business, big business government.
segments.zh: 长期处于那种情况并受到约束，显然政府不想被称作反商业、反大企业的政府。

segments.en: But now, you know, with all the allegations that have taken place, certainly they would have the fodder to go after them and sort of constrain them in that situation,
segments.zh: 但现在，随着所有指控的发生，他们肯定有理由追究并在那 situation 中约束它们，

segments.en: and I guess that, well, you know, there's a lot of questions being asked around that, otherwise, and investors are struggling to try and make those assumptions for future revenue,
segments.zh: 我想，围绕这一点有很多问题被提出，否则，市场参与者难以尝试为未来收入做出那些假设，

segments.en: future margins, and those factors, given what could be taking place, but obviously that, whether that clears the debt with a new CEO coming aboard is another factor,
segments.zh: 未来利润率等因素，鉴于可能发生的情况，但显然新CEO上任能否解决债务是另一个因素，

segments.en: but at the moment, the market seeing this, is pretty much a singular story.
segments.zh: 但目前市场看到的，基本是单一叙事。
